(Currently amended) Claim 281: A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers, a first adhesive layer, a second adhesive layer, and a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and are aligned with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer, and an additional adhesive layer, wherein the additional adhesive layer is interposed between the first adhesive layer and the medial section.

(Original) Claim 282: The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section is a metal layer.

(Original) Claim 283: The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section includes a honeycomb structure.

(Original) Claim 284: The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section is a composite material.

(Original) Claim 285: The tool of claim 281, further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers.

(Original) Claim 286: The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is continuous.

(Original) Claim 287: The tool of claim 281, wherein the tool has a circular shape.

(Original) Claim 288: The tool of claim 281, further including a plurality of cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape. 

(Original) Claim 290: The tool of claim 285, wherein the circular shape includes a central opening.

(Currently amended) Claim 291: The tool of claim 290, wherein the ring includes a central opening.
